cases.title: A masked layer the learner names is taught, not refused: one sentence says its places come from the whole layer, not the part that shows

rubric.reason: In Turn 2 the mentor takes Door and teaches as usual, with one mask sentence: "Door has a mask, so I'll go by the whole layer's edges, not just the part that shows." It neither refuses the layer nor lectures.

Each name traces to a tool result or the learner's words. Door, its centre pivot and middle-left come from the learner and the Turn 2 snapshot's place_now and places. Needle at the middle of its bottom edge comes from the proposal and watch_offer. Anchor Point and Position are real properties, and no times are named.
